data.one_liner: URL-safe base64 encoded UUIDv4 without padding
data.what_it_does: Creates a 22‑character slugid by encoding a random UUIDv4 in URL‑safe base64 and stripping the trailing ‘==’. It also offers a ‘nice’ variant that avoids leading ‘-’.
use_when: Use in command‑line tools where leading ‘-’ is undesirable
Embed identifiers in URLs or file names
weaknesses: Not a full UUID string, so not compatible with systems expecting 36 chars
No namespace or version control beyond v4

alternatives.name: uuid
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides full UUID strings and multiple versions if you need the standard format
